preparation.infusion_time: Administration rate and infusion duration are regimen-dependent. Because of the calcium content, intravenous administration should not exceed 160 mg/min.

warnings: Do not administer leucovorin intrathecally.
Do not exceed 160 mg/min when administered intravenously.
Leucovorin dose and timing are regimen-dependent, particularly for methotrexate rescue.
Do not mix calcium folinate in the same infusion as 5-fluorouracil unless compatibility has been specifically established for the exact products and conditions.
Monitor methotrexate concentrations and renal function when leucovorin is used for high-dose methotrexate rescue.
Leucovorin does not reverse the toxic effects of folic acid antagonists when administered too late in the rescue setting.
Inspect the solution visually for particulate matter and discoloration before administration.
